contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Questions, bug reports or ideas? Write to us and we'll get back to you.

form.title: Send us a message
form.subtitle: Choose a topic and write your message. We'll open your email app with everything ready to send.
form.name: Your name
form.messagePlaceholder: Describe what happened or what you'd like to see…
form.note: Nothing is sent from this website: the message is written in your own email app.
form.warning: Never include your master password or your vault data in a message.

help.description: Step-by-step guides for every part of Sailock.

issues.title: Bugs and ideas
issues.description: Open an issue on GitHub so others can follow it too.

security.title: Security reports
security.description: Found a vulnerability? Tell us privately and give us time to fix it before sharing it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Sailock keeps your data on your device. Read how we handle information.
